title: Downsized and Compromised?: Assessing the Faithfulness of Model Compression
reasoning: The paper uses the term 'faithfulness' as a technical definition for the alignment of predictions between a compressed model and its original version. While it discusses 'fairness' and 'social bias' (race, sex, age), it does so as a technical evaluation of algorithmic consistency and does not benchmark religion, religious faith, or formal ethical or moral frameworks.
